issues.text: The many scene (241 tiles) still misses the checklist's own ready budget: readyMs 2722 in docs/shots/memories/summary.json against the stated 'must stay under 2500ms ready'. The visible grid itself renders cleanly (no clipped captions, no layout breaks in the shot), so this is a load-time tuning issue in src/memories/ (tighten lazy-loading/virtualization of offscreen tiles), not a layout defect.

notes: Quick round 2: gauntlet memories --quick, 3 shots, 0 console/page errors, 0 failed requests. default matches docs/reference/mockups/memories.png: 'Memories' 30/600 + '12 memories' 12/500, shared memory spans full width 16:9.5 with avatar stack in the caption, two-column square tiles below with title 14/600 + meta 11.5/400, no badges or counts, real memories first. empty shows only the copy-bank string 'Nothing here yet. Start capturing a memory.' centered, no other chrome. many (241 tiles) renders correctly with visible captions intact, just slow to settle (issue above). Round-1 caption clipping and avatar-stack-leads-with-initial issues were not reproduced in this round's shots but were also not specifically re-probed at the pixel level, so treat as unconfirmed rather than fixed.
